```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar(),
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income Across Texas Counties",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
